Package cafe94.system.controller.staff

Class WorkingHoursPopupController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.staff.WorkingHoursPopupController
public class WorkingHoursPopupController extends Object
Controller for the Working Hours popup in the Cafe94 system.

Allows managers to view and edit a staff member's working schedule over 5 days, including both "hours to work" and "total hours worked". Validates input and updates the associated Staff object.

Integrates with DataSaver and AppState to ensure persistence.
